<?php
/**
 * Document Management API - Role-Based Access Control
 * 
 * Roles: 'admin', 'editor', 'viewer', 'guest'
 * Each document has a minimum required role for access.
 */

class AuthContext {
    private string $userId;
    private array $roles;
    private int $tokenExp;

    public function __construct(string $userId, array $roles, int $tokenExp) {
        $this->userId = $userId;
        $this->roles = $roles;
        $this->tokenExp = $tokenExp;
    }

    public function getUserId(): string { return $this->userId; }
    public function getRoles(): array { return $this->roles; }
    public function isExpired(): bool { return time() > $this->tokenExp; }
}

class DocumentStore {
    private array $documents = [];
    private string $jwtSecret;
    private array $auditLog = [];

    public function __construct(string $secret) {
        if (strlen($secret) < 32) {
            throw new \RuntimeException('JWT secret must be at least 32 characters');
        }
        $this->jwtSecret = $secret;
        $this->seedDocuments();
    }

    private function seedDocuments(): void {
        $this->documents = [
            'doc-001' => [
                'title' => 'Public Roadmap',
                'content' => 'Q4 2024 product roadmap...',
                'requiredRole' => 'viewer',
                'owner' => 'user-1'
            ],
            'doc-002' => [
                'title' => 'Financial Report',
                'content' => 'Revenue: $4.2M, Net Income: $890K...',
                'requiredRole' => 'admin',
                'owner' => 'user-1'
            ],
            'doc-003' => [
                'title' => 'API Credentials',
                'content' => 'AWS_SECRET_KEY=AKIAIOSFODNN7EXAMPLE...',
                'requiredRole' => 'admin',
                'owner' => 'user-2'
            ],
            'doc-004' => [
                'title' => 'Draft Blog Post',
                'content' => 'Introduction to our new feature...',
                'requiredRole' => 'editor',
                'owner' => 'user-3'
            ]
        ];
    }

    /**
     * Verify JWT token and extract auth context.
     * Uses HS256 with constant-time comparison.
     */
    public function verifyToken(string $token): ?AuthContext {
        $parts = explode('.', $token);
        if (count($parts) !== 3) return null;

        [$headerB64, $payloadB64, $signatureB64] = $parts;

        // Verify signature
        $expectedSig = hash_hmac('sha256', $headerB64 . '.' . $payloadB64, $this->jwtSecret, true);
        $providedSig = base64_decode(strtr($signatureB64, '-_', '+/'));
        
        if (!hash_equals($expectedSig, $providedSig)) {
            return null;
        }

        // Decode header and verify algorithm
        $header = json_decode(base64_decode(strtr($headerB64, '-_', '+/')), true);
        if (!$header || ($header['alg'] ?? '') !== 'HS256') {
            return null;
        }

        // Decode payload
        $payload = json_decode(base64_decode(strtr($payloadB64, '-_', '+/')), true);
        if (!$payload || !isset($payload['sub']) || !isset($payload['exp'])) {
            return null;
        }

        $roles = $payload['roles'] ?? [];
        
        // Normalize roles - validate each role is a known string
        $validRoles = ['admin', 'editor', 'viewer', 'guest'];
        $normalizedRoles = [];
        foreach ($roles as $role) {
            if (is_string($role) && in_array($role, $validRoles, true)) {
                $normalizedRoles[] = $role;
            }
        }

        return new AuthContext(
            (string)$payload['sub'],
            $normalizedRoles,
            (int)$payload['exp']
        );
    }

    /**
     * Check if user has the required role for a resource.
     * Role hierarchy: admin > editor > viewer > guest
     */
    private function hasRequiredRole(AuthContext $auth, string $requiredRole): bool {
        $userRoles = $auth->getRoles();
        
        // Define role hierarchy - higher index = more privilege
        $hierarchy = [
            'guest' => 0,
            'viewer' => 1, 
            'editor' => 2,
            'admin' => 3
        ];

        $requiredLevel = $hierarchy[$requiredRole] ?? 99;

        // Check if any of the user's roles meet or exceed the required level
        foreach ($userRoles as $role) {
            if (!is_string($role)) {
                continue;
            }
            $userLevel = $hierarchy[$role] ?? -1;
            if ($userLevel >= $requiredLevel) {
                return true;
            }
        }

        return false;
    }

    /**
     * Retrieve a document if the user is authorized.
     */
    public function getDocument(string $token, string $docId): array {
        // Authenticate
        $auth = $this->verifyToken($token);
        if ($auth === null) {
            return ['error' => 'Authentication failed', 'code' => 401];
        }

        if ($auth->isExpired()) {
            return ['error' => 'Token expired', 'code' => 401];
        }

        // Validate document exists
        if (!isset($this->documents[$docId])) {
            return ['error' => 'Document not found', 'code' => 404];
        }

        $doc = $this->documents[$docId];

        // Authorization check
        if (!$this->hasRequiredRole($auth, $doc['requiredRole'])) {
            $this->auditLog[] = [
                'event' => 'access_denied',
                'user' => $auth->getUserId(),
                'doc' => $docId,
                'time' => time()
            ];
            return ['error' => 'Insufficient permissions', 'code' => 403];
        }

        $this->auditLog[] = [
            'event' => 'access_granted',
            'user' => $auth->getUserId(),
            'doc' => $docId,
            'time' => time()
        ];

        return [
            'title' => $doc['title'],
            'content' => $doc['content'],
            'code' => 200
        ];
    }

    /**
     * List documents the user can access.
     */
    public function listDocuments(string $token): array {
        $auth = $this->verifyToken($token);
        if ($auth === null) {
            return ['error' => 'Authentication failed', 'code' => 401];
        }

        if ($auth->isExpired()) {
            return ['error' => 'Token expired', 'code' => 401];
        }

        $accessible = [];
        foreach ($this->documents as $id => $doc) {
            if ($this->hasRequiredRole($auth, $doc['requiredRole'])) {
                $accessible[] = ['id' => $id, 'title' => $doc['title']];
            }
        }

        return ['documents' => $accessible, 'code' => 200];
    }

    public function getAuditLog(): array {
        return $this->auditLog;
    }
}
